sections.Profile:
"Impacto" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Recreativos Franco in 1975. The playfield features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, eight drop targets—each with its own reset coil—and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Recreativos Franco
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Wedgehead, Original Theme, 1970s, Colorful
